facts.fact: Winter 打算抓到后让她披红斗篷游街
facts.anchor: When he caught her, she would be paraded through town wearing it so everyone would see his prize

facts.fact: 确认她是 Red Riding Hood 后，旧日怜悯消失
facts.anchor: any compassion he might’ve felt for her before was gone the moment he discovered she was Red Riding Hood

facts.fact: 他推断弟弟在肉店——转向抓人质
facts.anchor: She had a brother who wasn’t at home, which meant he was likely at their meat shop

facts.fact: 肉店里的男人是 Winter 常去妓院的保镖（Nareth）
facts.anchor: The brown-haired man was the bodyguard at one of the brothels Winter frequented

facts.fact: Nareth 撒盐迷眼并喊 Cyan 快跑
facts.anchor: he withdrew his hand from his apron pocket and flung salt in Winter’s face

facts.fact: Winter 拳打 Nareth 下巴、颊、鼻
facts.anchor: His knuckles cracked against Nareth’s jaw, his chin, his nose
The way he clutched at his ribs, Winter was certain he’d broken a few

facts.fact: 留话：明早日落前到庄园自首换弟弟
facts.anchor: she’ll turn herself over to me at my manor before tomorrow’s sunset

facts.fact: 威胁 Cyan：动一下就杀了你们俩
facts.anchor: If you move in the slightest, I’ll kill you both

facts.fact: 结尾：他记得篮中的婴儿
facts.anchor: I haven’t seen you since you were a wee thing in a basket with your sister
